_about: Every file a daily model lane must load from the cloud image. `models/**/*.pkl` and `data/new_build/` are git-ignored, so a lane's file reaches Railway only when it is force-added. tests/test_model_lane_artifacts.py checks this file against git and against the loader scripts.

lanes.note: Loaded from the champion copy, byte-identical to soft_label_challenger/champion_model.pkl (MD5 9fe8fe9cf22f54b5ca580bee11ad34e0 in the 2026-09-19 Supabase archive).

lanes.impact: Step 9.1b exits 1 every morning (FileNotFoundError in the Railway log, 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-14). velo_model_comparison_ledger.mp_top_pick is filled on 22 of 393 November races.
lanes.repair: Operator: force-add the file from the laptop (as was done for No-RPR in NORPR-SHIP-01), after checking it loads under the production sklearn/lightgbm pins.

lanes.impact: Step 9.1 passes, but its packet records WIN_GATE_NOT_LOADED and FRAME_GATE_NOT_LOADED (Railway log 2026-11-12). The Radical Shadow runs without either gate.
lanes.repair: Operator: force-add both files from the laptop, or retire the gates from the Radical Shadow.
